title: known positive: lint job on a 16-core larger runner

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-16-cores
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npx eslint .

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-16-cores
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

title: legitimate exception: runs-on is an expression, runner not known statically

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest-16-cores]
    steps:
      - run: npx eslint .

title: legitimate exception: a job named 'Rust lints (fmt, check, clippy, tests, doc)' compiles and tests, so the large runner is justified (real: rerun-io/rerun)

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  rs-lints:
    name: Rust lints (fmt, check, clippy, tests, doc)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-16-cores
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pixi run rs-check

title: similar negative: cargo clippy is a compile, so a lint-named job running it is not light

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-16-cores
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
